proved_step: Lemma L1 (elementary): a signature whose support has size 1 is a matchgate, because the parity condition holds trivially and every four-term MGI has at most one nonzero term. Hence each non-matchgate vertex has |supp| >= 2 and contributes log2|supp| >= 1 to lambda. Consequence: lambda(Omega,T) >= number of non-matchgate vertices.
